Too many had fallen. "Never go to the Nether again" could not outrun it.
More monsters surged from the Nether. Villages were raided. Builders died in the wild.
Could the dead be brought back?
They dug through old tomes, hunted forbidden lore, and began to practice the dark arts.
They learned to summon. To bind souls. To call Vex out of the night as scouts.
Their eyes grew cruel, their robes turned deep purple, they wore pointed hats,
and could call ravagers and Vex out of thin air.
The villagers grew afraid. They named them the Scourge villagers.
In this age the Scourge villagers never harmed villagers or Builders.
They had taken up the dark arts to fight death itself.
They even drove the monsters from around the villages, only looking more fearsome.
